purpose: Third surface-authorship sensitivity pilot: keep the matched Dharma Connection leave-one-source-group-out design from PR #67 while equalizing every retained train and held-out document to one deterministic 50-word window, so each author contributes exactly 250 training words per fold.

fold_training.joel_rule: two non-heldout Joel-only Dharma supplement documents plus the three non-heldout matched evaluation-thread Joel documents; omit only the named training-only 13-word Anatta-email row that cannot supply the precommitted 50-word window
fold_training.control_rule: five largest explicit-speaker non-overlap Dharma profile documents per control selected before normalization, using the same deterministic ranking rule as PR #67

short_training_exclusions.reason: First live 50-word preflight found this training-only Joel extraction has 13 whitespace-token words, so it cannot satisfy the precommitted 50-word window. It is not one of the ten held-out evaluation documents. Runtime must reverify that it remains under 50 words before exclusion.

length_normalization.preflight_correction: The initial six-document/300-word design failed before model fitting because one training-only Joel source had 13 words. The window size and the ten held-out evaluation documents are unchanged. Rather than lower the window after seeing feasibility, the infeasible non-test row is explicitly removed and all classes are reduced to five training documents / 250 words per fold.
length_normalization.reason: PR #67 balanced six documents per author but Joel supplied only about 776-1276 training words per fold versus 9525 for David Vardy and 12119 for Stian Gudmundsen Høiland. The corrected sensitivity removes that text-mass asymmetry while preserving source-group separation, candidate authors, evaluation threads, and the precommitted 50-word window.

interpretation.comparison_target: Compare directly with the matched-platform whole-document result in state/IDIOLECT-SURFACE-SVM-MATCHED-PLATFORM-CV-RESULT-2026-08-18.json. If character-based Joel attribution remains poor after exact text-budget equalization, document-length/profile-mass imbalance is not sufficient to explain the weak surface signal and surface SVM should be deprioritized as the operational calibration target. If it improves materially, expand the length-normalized evaluation before drawing any idiolect conclusion.
interpretation.stop_rule: Do not repeatedly tune window size/position or swap training sources in response to model outcomes on these same ten held-out documents. The only post-preflight source change is the explicitly documented removal of a 13-word training-only source that could not satisfy the 50-word transform before any model fit.
